text:
In Costa Rica

the oxcart drivers sing


They walk with

mandolins on the roads


And the carts

are painted like macaws,


And the oxen go

with colored ribbons


And little bells

and flowers on their horns.


When it is the coffee

harvest in Costa Rica,


And the carts go

loaded with coffee.


And there are bands

in the town squares,


And in San José

the balconies and windows

are full of girls and flowers


And the girls

circle around in the park.


And the president

walks on foot

in San José.

translation.title: In Costa Rica
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the civic contrast of a singing, walkable Costa Rica with a president on foot.
